messages:
maria_ae: Partner asked us to include a telemetry & observability appendix in the marketplace refkit (prometheus metrics + OTLP traces + a sample Grafana dashboard). Can we map owners and a short plan?

rachel_s: +1. Customers always ask for ready-made dashboards for latency, token throughput, and cost-per-token. We should include a minimal Prometheus scrape config and a Grafana JSON model.

noah_g: I can own the dashboard and example alerts. Suggest metrics: redwood_inference_request_latency_ms (p50/p95), redwood_inference_tokens_total, redwood_inference_errors_total, node_gpu_utilization, and cache_hit_ratio.

sam_k: CI/packaging note: add a telemetry module to the Terraform examples that can optionally provision a Grafana + Prometheus stack in the demo namespace. Keep it optional (marketplace customers may use their own observability).

eng_obs: For tracing, recommend OTEL collector config that exports traces to vendor (OTLP/HTTP) and also emits a lightweight local prometheus exporter. We'll include a sample collector config and a helm values snippet.

telemetry_bot: Partner workspace created: https://redwood-internal/partners/spaces/marketplace-refkit-telemetry. Checklist attached. :white_check_mark:

maria_ae: Good. Also include an example of instrumented inference client metrics (SDK) so partners can wire server-side metrics into the same schema.

rachel_s: I'll draft the Grafana panels: latency heatmap, tokens over time, per-model cost (tokens * cost_per_token), and a small playbook section describing typical alert thresholds (p95 > 300ms, error rate > 0.5%).

noah_g: Alerts: create pager-duty recommended severity mapping, example Prometheus rules:```yaml
groups:
  - name: marketplace-refkit-alerts
    rules:
      - alert: HighInferenceP95
        expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) > 0.3
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: page
        annotations:
          summary: "p95 latency high for {{ $labels.model }}"
```

sam_k: Terraform snippet to optionally deploy telemetry stack (very small):```hcl
module "telemetry" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/refkits//telemetry"
  deploy = var.enable_telemetry  # bool
  namespace = "refkit-monitoring"
  grafana_admin_password = var.grafana_admin_password
}
```

eng_obs: Also include a curlable health endpoint that returns metric health and last successful trace export, e.g.:```bash
curl -s https://$DEMO_IP/monitoring/health | jq '.'
# expected: {"metrics_ok":true,"last_trace_export":"2026-03-20T17:04:00Z"}
```

maria_ae: Ownership: noah_g = dashboard + alert rules, rachel_s = docs + playbook, sam_k = telemetry module + CI job that validates dashboards render in headless Grafana test, eng_obs = OTEL collector config + tracing examples.

rachel_s: Docs TODOs: example Prometheus scrape config, OTEL collector snippet, Grafana JSON model, alert playbook with runbook steps (how to investigate high p95, token cost spike, and cache-miss storms).

telemetry_bot: Adding nightly check: render dashboard image and run smoke curl test against demo. Will post result to partner workspace.

noah_g: Small note on costs: include a dashboard panel that multiplies tokens by a `cost_per_token` variable so partners can estimate monthly spend for demo traffic.

sam_k: CI: add a job that deploys demo with telemetry.enabled=true, waits for metrics to appear (up metric + tokens > 0) and then validates a sample panel image is non-empty. Keeps packaging reviewers happy.

eng_obs: Security note: make sure the dashboard and Prometheus endpoints are not public by default. README should show how to bind Grafana to the demo VPC and use OIDC for access. Include a short KMS example for storing grafana_admin_password.

maria_ae: timeline: partner PM wants telemetry preview as part of the demo next Friday. Let's freeze artifacts by Wednesday EOD so we have time to iterate.

rachel_s: I'll create the docs PR today and link the Grafana JSON.

noah_g: I'll prototype the alert rules and a sample screenshot by Tuesday.

sam_k: I'll add a CI job for telemetry smoke tests and wire the module into the example terraform.

maria_ae: Thanks team 680. Ping here for any infra or security hurdles and we'll escalate to partner PM.
